Imputed: the paper's test (a case in which only one method qualifies counts as a maximal difference in its favour; $n=68$). Dropped: only the cases in which both qualify. Wilcoxon: zero differences ($|d|\le10^{-9}$~pp) dropped (paper); Pratt: zeros kept in the ranking. All $p$ values Holm-adjusted within the stated family and version. Only 1st/2nd: cases in which only the first / second method qualifies; Zeros: cases with $|d|\le10^{-9}$ among those in which both qualify.
